---
title: "Draft of Research Paper for Peer-Review"
---

:::{.callout-important}

Due at the beginning of class. Submit on Canvas and bring a hard copy.

:::

## Purpose

The goal of this assignment is to help you get a full draft of your paper and learn how to give and take feedback.


## Task

Submit a full draft of your research paper and bring a hard copy to class. Then, during class, you will provide feedback to one of your classmates on their research project (and they will give feedback on your project).



## Criteria for Success

A successful submission will:

1. Have meaningful content in each of the required sections of an empirical paper
2. Provide ruthlessly constructive (but nice) feedback to a peer
